messages:
Priya: Quick sync on the network partition postmortem follow-ups. Need owners for short-term remediation + long-term recurrence plan. I sketched roles below, pls chime.

Liam: I can own short-term infra fixes (RED-6123) and the emergency ACL rollback. ETA 3 days. ACK.

Evelyn: I'll take the runtime tuning and validation tests (RED-6124). ETA 1 week. Will add perf gates to the ticket.

Carlos: I'll handle detection/alerts + runbook updates (RED-6125). Need to add dedupe and severity thresholds.

Priya: Proposed RACI for the incident: Liam (R), Priya (A), Evelyn (C), Carlos (I). @Liam ok to be primary for the deploy?

Liam: Yup. I'll pair with @Carlos for the deploy window and be on-call the rollout day. :thumbsup:

Evelyn: Filed RED-6124 with a CI smoke test matrix and a checklist. Added note about validating under simulated packet-loss.

Carlos: Created RED-6125 and linked the updated runbook. I'll add an alert dedupe window and a dashboard tile for connection drops.

oncall-bot: Incident resolved by Priya at 2026-02-04T14:10:00Z 1: severity lowered to P3.

Priya: Owners please paste PR links, KB links, and short rollout notes into the Jira tickets by Thursday COB. Minimal checklist below:
```
- link postmortem doc
- attach PRs + config diffs
- add rollout timeline & rollback criteria
- define success metrics (error rate, reconverge time)
```

Liam: Will add canary window: Thu 9am UTC, 1hr. Adding validation script and smoke logs to RED-6123.

Evelyn: Planning to run a perf baseline Tuesday and attach graphs to the ticket. Also opening an epic RED-6200 to track recurring partition patterns.

Carlos: For alerts: will lower sensitivity on the transient-ttl rule and add a 5m dedupe. Linking dashboards to RED-6200 for long-term trending.

Priya: Good catch on recurrence. Please capture recurrence indicators (time-of-day, region, service path) in the epic so we can prioritize.

Liam: One blocker: need access to the test harness for packet-loss sim. @Priya can you grant?

Priya: Granted access to the test harness and added steps in the runbook.

Evelyn: CI perf baselines completed, attaching CSVs to RED-6124. There's a small degradation at 90th pct under loss but within rollback thresholds.

Carlos: Runbook rehearsal scheduled next Mon 11am PT. I'll invite the oncall rotation and add the rehearsal notes to RED-6125.

Priya: Final ask: owners, confirm your ETA in the Jira comments and set watchers for the SRE rotation lead. I'll close the action tracker once links are in. Thanks all. :pray:
